proof_body:
by
  intro X _ _ f M hb he
  have hA : Equicontinuous ((↑) : (Set.range f) → X → ℝ) := by
    intro x U hU
    filter_upwards [he x U hU] with y hy
    rintro ⟨_, n, rfl⟩
    exact hy n
  have hcl : IsCompact (closure (Set.range f)) :=
    BoundedContinuousFunction.arzela_ascoli (Set.Icc (-M) M) isCompact_Icc (Set.range f)
      (by
        rintro _ x ⟨n, rfl⟩
        exact abs_le.1 (hb n x)) hA
  obtain ⟨g, -, φ, hφ, hg⟩ := hcl.tendsto_subseq (x := f) (fun n => subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self n))
  exact ⟨g, φ, hφ, (BoundedContinuousFunction.tendsto_iff_tendstoUniformly).1 hg⟩
target_source: ∀ (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : ℕ → BoundedContinuousFunction X ℝ) (M : ℝ), (∀ n x, |f n x| ≤ M) → Equicontinuous (fun n x => f n x) → ∃ (g : BoundedContinuousFunction X ℝ) (φ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono φ ∧ TendstoUniformly (fun n x => f (φ n) x) (fun x => g x) Filter.atTop
